contracts.rule: engines are spawned by path, never imported; engines do not import experiments
the matched Metronome baseline and Conveyor use the same worker observation producer; upstream vanilla Metronome remains a reference target

the abstract generated-token count is distinct from gateway delivery; output_token_cap is a generation upper bound, never a minimum delivery requirement; both current first-party workers set ignore_eos=True and normally run to their unequal per-segment decode caps, which formal matched-system comparisons must equalize

first-party validation rejects service RPC errors, session death, client-health failure, malformed delivery records, and output-cap mismatch; output below the cap remains a diagnostic observation rather than an automatic correctness failure

initial-context evidence requires every requested prefill to complete before periodic releases, excludes initialization output from later delivery, releases the automatic-eviction hold without evicting at the barrier, and rejects initialization timeout logs

partial KV eviction runs on an idle scheduler transition, releases request ownership before evicting selected GPU tail blocks, records host-backing coverage, and treats coverage gaps as recomputation rather than complete reload
session activity, block residency, host-backing coverage, transfer state, and request ownership are separate dimensions; block pools and runtime request state own physical truth

the pinned client uses non-namespaced /tmp shard files and shared ports, so runs must not overlap; managed workflow deletes stale shard and aggregate files, requires every expected shard plus the controller to recreate results, and cleans temporary files on exit
KV prefetching changes timing only; capacity deferral, lateness, input overtaking, or later cache eviction falls back to on-demand reload or recomputation
formal evidence is clean; dirty diagnostic evidence carries a reconstructable patch artifact
